notes.title: Steam Deck Support and Optimal Settings
notes.content:
The team has worked hard to ensure compatibility with Fastival on a Steam Deck.  You'll want to tweak your settings a bit to get the game running well:

[olist]
[*] In the main menu, go to Settings > Video
[*] Set the resolution to 1280x800 (the native Steam Deck resolution)
[*] Set the graphics quality to Medium for ~60fps
[/olist]

[url=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2477621909499938856/AC9DDF2ACDB8911F58B902240537300193042351/][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2477621909499938856/AC9DDF2ACDB8911F58B902240537300193042351/[/img][/url]

The game's default 1080p on Epic will not run well on a Steam Deck, but once you make the changes above, it's a buttery smooth framerate.
